The Price of Ingenuity#464.dst: 是你的一个指挥官跟我汇总了情况。我应该从你这里听到才对！所以……你的角度是什么？感觉你在无视这个问题。
The Price of Ingenuity#464.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Price of Ingenuity#465.src: ...Soosu? Soosu, are you listening? I asked you a question!
The Price of Ingenuity#465.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Price of Ingenuity#466.src: Hm? Yeah, yeah, sure. Hey, could you fetch me some bolts?
The Price of Ingenuity#466.dst: 嗯？是是是，当然。嘿，能帮我拿些螺栓吗？
The Price of Ingenuity#466.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#467.src: ...fine, sure- But please, we have to round this out, Soosu. You have to get involved.
The Price of Ingenuity#467.dst: ……好，行——不过拜托，我们得把这件事办圆满，Soosu。你得参与进来。
The Price of Ingenuity#467.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Price of Ingenuity#468.src: Oh, right, about Flowers. Could you go check if his body picked up any parts while walking that I could use?
The Price of Ingenuity#468.dst: 噢，对了，关于 Flowers。你能去看看他的身体走来走去的时候有没有捡到什么我能用的零件吗？
The Price of Ingenuity#468.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#469.src: I knew letting you work in here was irrational. There's such a greater sum of problems than your toys! You're acting like a child, but you aren't one!
The Price of Ingenuity#469.dst: 我就知道让你在这里工作不理智。问题的总和比你的玩具大多了！你表现得像个小孩，可你不是！
The Price of Ingenuity#469.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Price of Ingenuity#470.src: I know you can do such good work if you just apply yourself! Why are you just ignoring a high-ranking defector and a Cursed exponentiating each others' threat?!
The Price of Ingenuity#470.dst: 我知道只要你用心，就能做出很好的成果！为什么你要无视一个高层叛逃者和一个受诅者正在让彼此的威胁呈指数级增长？！
The Price of Ingenuity#470.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Price of Ingenuity#471.src: Do you think you're better than me, Zhiraok?
The Price of Ingenuity#471.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#472.src: Oh, look at Soosu, always so inattentive and clueless, always ignoring the needs of her district, always cooped up in her laboratory.
The Price of Ingenuity#472.dst: 噢，看看 Soosu，总是那么心不在焉、什么都不懂，总是无视她辖区的需求，总是窝在她的实验室里。
The Price of Ingenuity#472.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#473.src: Who even cares about the work she does? The projects she's assigned?! Who even cares that she knows, she knows, she KNOWS!!!!
The Price of Ingenuity#473.dst: 谁在乎她做的工作？她被指派的项目？！谁在乎她知道、她知道、她知道！！！！
The Price of Ingenuity#473.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#474.src: ...Hm! Maybe you are better, Z. If you weren't, maybe we wouldn't be here right now!!
The Price of Ingenuity#474.dst: ……哼！也许你真的比较强，Z。要是你不强，也许我们现在就不会在这里了！！
The Price of Ingenuity#474.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#475.src: I... ... ...I'm sorry Soosu. That...that wasn't my angle, I didn't mean t-
The Price of Ingenuity#475.dst: 我……………我很抱歉，Soosu。那……那不是我的角度，我不是那个意——
The Price of Ingenuity#475.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Price of Ingenuity#476.src: But you did! Hand me cog C-{~}, would you?
The Price of Ingenuity#476.dst: 可你就是！把 C-{~} 号齿轮递给我，好吗？
The Price of Ingenuity#476.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#477.src: ...alright. I just want to reach the end of this sequence as fast as possible.
The Price of Ingenuity#477.dst: ……好吧。我只想尽快走完这个序列。
The Price of Ingenuity#477.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Price of Ingenuity#478.src: That makes two of us. I'm working on it. You can stop bugging me about it!!
The Price of Ingenuity#478.dst: 我们俩都这么想。我在弄了。你可以别再烦我了！！
The Price of Ingenuity#478.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#479.src: ...maybe I should've been paying more attention. I didn't realize her project was putting so much weight on your shoulders. And I promised to help, too...
The Price of Ingenuity#479.dst: ……也许我该多注意一点。我没发现她的项目让你肩上承受了这么大的压力。而且我还答应过要帮忙……
The Price of Ingenuity#479.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Price of Ingenuity#480.src: Preliminary results suggest significantly improved utilization of energy, and reduced pollution. (Cleaner air? May help.)
The Price of Ingenuity#480.dst: 初步结果显示能源利用率大幅提升，污染也有所减少。(空气更干净？也许有帮助。)

The Price of Ingenuity#482.src: Return to the Steel Feather through Yusanu's tunnel at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
The Price of Ingenuity#482.dst: 穿过 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的 Yusanu 隧道回到钢羽。

The Price of Ingenuity#483.src: ...what was that?! What were they DOING there?!
The Price of Ingenuity#483.dst: ……刚才那是怎么回事？！他们在那里干什么？！
The Price of Ingenuity#483.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#484.src: I- I- I don't know! A surprise visit? I didn't... I didn't think...
The Price of Ingenuity#484.dst: 我——我——我不知道！突击视察？我没……我没想到……
The Price of Ingenuity#484.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#485.src: So, "letting off some steam", huh?! Oh, sure, bring Sovereign Zhiraok along with you!! Why not!!!
The Price of Ingenuity#485.dst: 所以，“发泄一下”，是吧？！哦，当然，还把 Zhiraok 统领一起带来！！有何不可！！！
The Price of Ingenuity#485.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#486.src: We almost got caught! We- oh god, we... we almost got caught...
The Price of Ingenuity#486.dst: 我们差点就被抓到了！我们——哦天哪，我们……差点就被抓到了……
The Price of Ingenuity#486.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#487.src: ...what are we doing? Why did- why did we do that? That was so...
The Price of Ingenuity#487.dst: ……我们在干什么？为什么——为什么我们要那样做？那太……
The Price of Ingenuity#487.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#488.src: You're asking ME?! Yeah, Rex, why did we do that?!
The Price of Ingenuity#488.dst: 你问我？！是啊，Rex，我们为什么要那样做？！
The Price of Ingenuity#488.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#489.src: Stop. Just... stop, for a second. I need to... think.
The Price of Ingenuity#489.dst: 停。先……停一下。我需要……想想。
The Price of Ingenuity#489.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#490.src: ...damn it. Damn it, damn it, damn it! Stupid, impulsive... ugh!!
The Price of Ingenuity#490.dst: ……该死。该死，该死，该死！又蠢又冲动……唉！！
The Price of Ingenuity#490.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#492.src: No, I... I'm not. I'm sorry, I- I should know better by now...
The Price of Ingenuity#492.dst: 不，我……我不好。对不起，我——我早该学乖了……
The Price of Ingenuity#492.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#493.src: It... doesn't matter. It's too late to take it back. We can... we can use it as a trump card. Yusanu, please tell me you can figure out what it is.
The Price of Ingenuity#493.dst: 那……不重要了。现在收回也来不及了。我们可以……我们可以把它当王牌。Yusanu，拜托告诉我你能弄清楚它是什么。
The Price of Ingenuity#493.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#494.src: I... I don't know. I never got to work too closely with it, so... I have no idea what it is. If I work with it, maybe I can get somewhere. But...
The Price of Ingenuity#494.dst: 我……我不知道。我从来没机会近距离研究它，所以……我完全不知道它是什么。如果我去研究，也许能有些进展。可是……
The Price of Ingenuity#494.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#495.src: Good enough, I guess. Come on, let's get back. I need to... find Mora. And you need to tell everyone what you've been up to.
The Price of Ingenuity#495.dst: 我想也够了。来吧，我们回去吧。我得……去找 Mora。而你得告诉大家你一直在干什么。
The Price of Ingenuity#495.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#496.src: You collectively decide that leaving Flowers be is probably best for everyone involved.
The Price of Ingenuity#496.dst: 你们一致决定，别去打扰 Flowers 大概对大家都好。

The Price of Ingenuity#497.src: These vents are broken, and were blocked off for a reason. Proceeding further will be dangerous!
The Price of Ingenuity#497.dst: 这些通风口已经损坏，封起来是有原因的。继续前进会很危险！

The Price of Ingenuity#498.src: ...so just hiding what we did today isn't an option?
The Price of Ingenuity#498.dst: ……所以我们没法把今天做的事瞒下来？
The Price of Ingenuity#498.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#499.src: And let it come back to bite us later down the line? No thanks. Let's go.
The Price of Ingenuity#499.dst: 然后让它之后反咬我们一口？不了，谢谢。走吧。
The Price of Ingenuity#499.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#500.src: Really, Rex, are you... alright? I don't think I've ever seen-
The Price of Ingenuity#500.dst: 说真的，Rex，你……还好吗？我好像从来没见过——
The Price of Ingenuity#500.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#501.src: Don't. Don't push it. Not right now.
The Price of Ingenuity#501.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#502.src: Hey! You three, where the heck have you been all day?!
The Price of Ingenuity#502.dst: 嘿！你们三个，一整天都跑哪去了？！
The Price of Ingenuity#502.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#504.src: Yes, it's rather curious! I happened to speak to Syndra, and apparently there were no such "important tasks" assigned to you! She seemed rather clueless about the whole matter!
The Price of Ingenuity#504.dst: 是啊，这可真稀奇！我刚好跟 Syndra 聊了一下，看来根本没有什么交给你们的“重要任务”！她看起来对整件事一头雾水！
The Price of Ingenuity#504.speaker: Mora

The Price of Ingenuity#506.src: You know what happened, Mora. I- I messed up. Again.
The Price of Ingenuity#506.dst: 你知道发生了什么，Mora。我——我搞砸了。又一次。
The Price of Ingenuity#506.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#507.src: Huh? What do you mean, agai-
The Price of Ingenuity#507.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#508.src: Ah, Yuman, would you mind taking Yusanu along with you to go tell the others we'll be a little late to the meeting? I believe there will be some additional news today.
The Price of Ingenuity#508.dst: 啊，Yuman，能不能麻烦你带 Yusanu 一起去告诉其他人，我们开会会晚一点到？我相信今天会有一些额外的消息。
The Price of Ingenuity#508.speaker: Mora

The Price of Ingenuity#509.src: Uh... sure, I guess. Yus, can you tell me what's up while we walk?
The Price of Ingenuity#509.dst: 呃……行吧。Yus，边走边跟我说是怎么回事好吗？
The Price of Ingenuity#509.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#512.src: It's... bad. We stole something important from the Sovereign's workshop. It's... a long story. Yusanu should tell his part of it. But...
The Price of Ingenuity#512.dst: 很……糟。我们从统领的工作室偷了一个重要的东西。说来……话长。Yusanu 应该自己讲他那部分。可是……
The Price of Ingenuity#512.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#513.src: I see. I apologize, Rex, I should have been more attentive.
The Price of Ingenuity#513.dst: 我明白了。我很抱歉，Rex，我应该更留意的。
The Price of Ingenuity#513.speaker: Mora

The Price of Ingenuity#514.src: No! No, it's not your fault, I should have- I should have known I was being impulsive, I... I wasn't thinking straight.
The Price of Ingenuity#514.dst: 不！不，不是你的错，我应该——我应该知道自己在冲动，我……我那时候脑子不清楚。
The Price of Ingenuity#514.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#515.src: Ah. Of course, you don't know. I should have informed you the last time this happened...
The Price of Ingenuity#515.dst: 啊。当然，你还不知道。上次发生这种事的时候我就该告诉你的……
The Price of Ingenuity#515.speaker: Mora

The Price of Ingenuity#516.src: Rex has these... ah, "moods," sometimes, wherein she gets... overly excitable and impulsive. Many a time have they led her into trouble.
The Price of Ingenuity#516.dst: Rex 有时候会有这些……啊，“情绪”，那时候她会……过度兴奋又冲动。好多次都让她惹上了麻烦。
The Price of Ingenuity#516.speaker: Mora

The Price of Ingenuity#517.src: Ugh, I should know better by now! Especially here, especially now, when...
The Price of Ingenuity#517.dst: 唉，我现在早该学乖了！尤其是在这里，尤其是现在，明明……
The Price of Ingenuity#517.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#518.src: Well, what is done is done, and nevertheless, we must press on. Let's join the others for the meeting. Syndra has something important to tell us.
The Price of Ingenuity#518.dst: 嗯，做了就做了，无论如何，我们都得继续前进。我们去跟其他人开会吧。Syndra 有重要的事要告诉我们。
The Price of Ingenuity#518.speaker: Mora

The Price of Ingenuity#519.src: Attend the meeting in the Steel Feather at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Price of Ingenuity#520.src: There you are! Mora, Rex, what's going-
The Price of Ingenuity#520.speaker: Syndra

The Price of Ingenuity#521.src: Syndra, I believe that can wait. We've, ah, held up dinner long enough, I believe. If everyone is here, we should begin. First- Yusanu, what was it you had to tell us?
The Price of Ingenuity#521.dst: Syndra，我想那可以等等。我们，啊，已经耽搁晚饭够久了。如果大家都到齐了，就开始吧。首先——Yusanu，你有什么要跟我们说的？
The Price of Ingenuity#521.speaker: Quill

The Price of Ingenuity#522.src: ...sigh. Before I begin, I need to make it clear- I was doing what I thought was best for the Steel Feather.
The Price of Ingenuity#522.dst: ……唉。开始之前，我得先说清楚——我做的是我认为对钢羽最好的事。
The Price of Ingenuity#522.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#523.src: Yeah, man, good start... really instills confidence.
The Price of Ingenuity#523.dst: 对啊，老兄，开场白真不错……真让人放心。
The Price of Ingenuity#523.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#524.src: Yuman, please... let me get through this. Don't interrupt.
The Price of Ingenuity#524.dst: Yuman，拜托……让我说完。别打断我。
The Price of Ingenuity#524.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#525.src: So. So, so,so... The... the reason the crown has left us alone down here is because I have been working with Sovereign Soosu.
The Price of Ingenuity#525.dst: 所以。所以，所以，所以……王室之所以一直没来找我们麻烦……是因为我一直在跟 Soosu 统领合作。
The Price of Ingenuity#525.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#527.src: The reason we've been able to stay under the radar for so long is because of this, Yulie.
The Price of Ingenuity#527.dst: 我们之所以能这么久不被发现，就是因为这个，Yulie。
The Price of Ingenuity#527.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#528.src: The reason we can live here, leave our home, make use of the city's electricity... it's because of my collaboration.
The Price of Ingenuity#528.dst: 我们能住在这里、离开家、使用城里的电……都是因为我跟她合作。
The Price of Ingenuity#528.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#529.src: She said she saw potential in me. Told me that if I helped her in her workshops, then... then you all would be safe down here.
The Price of Ingenuity#529.dst: 她说她看到了我的潜力。告诉我如果我在她的工作室帮忙，那……那你们在下面就会安全。
The Price of Ingenuity#529.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#530.src: I didn't tell anybody because I knew you wouldn't get it. You'd think it was stupid, and risky, and a bad idea. Working with... with someone responsible for our problems.
The Price of Ingenuity#530.dst: 我没告诉任何人，因为我知道你们不会理解。你们会觉得那很蠢、很冒险、是个糟糕透顶的主意。跟……跟造成我们这些问题的人合作。
The Price of Ingenuity#530.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#531.src: And I knew it was risky. I did. But I thought that if I were to mess up, only I would be punished. You all would be safe.
The Price of Ingenuity#531.dst: 而我也知道很冒险。我知道。但我以为要是我搞砸了，受惩罚的只会是我。你们都会安全。
The Price of Ingenuity#531.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#532.src: ...now. I understand emotions are running high right now. I would ask everyone to take a step back, think through it logically, and remain c-
The Price of Ingenuity#532.dst: ……好了。我明白现在大家情绪都很激动。我请大家先退一步，理性地想清楚，保持冷——
The Price of Ingenuity#532.speaker: Quill

The Price of Ingenuity#533.src: Are you insane, Yusanu?! Of all the secrets you could have been keeping-
The Price of Ingenuity#533.dst: 你疯了吗，Yusanu？！你能瞒的秘密那么多——
The Price of Ingenuity#533.speaker: Yulie

The Price of Ingenuity#535.src: No, I don't think I will! Is that what the alarms were about? How long has this been going on? What was running through your head when you decided-
The Price of Ingenuity#535.dst: 不，我不觉得我会！警报就是因为这个吗？这种事多久了？你决定这么做的时候脑子里到底在想什么——
The Price of Ingenuity#535.speaker: Yulie

The Price of Ingenuity#536.src: As if you haven't been doing the same thing this whole time! Trying to put all the weight on your own shoulders, not getting help from anyone else!!
The Price of Ingenuity#536.dst: 说得好像你一直以来没在做一样的事！把所有担子都扛在自己肩上，谁的帮忙都不要！！
The Price of Ingenuity#536.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#537.src: So- so, y'know, I'm a little mad. He should have talked to us about it! But... he's telling us now. He's asking for help now.
The Price of Ingenuity#537.dst: 所以——所以，你懂的，我是有点生气。他应该跟我们商量的！可是……他现在告诉我们了。他现在在请我们帮忙。
The Price of Ingenuity#537.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#540.src: After yesterday's run-in with the soldiers... Soosu is demanding I hand over whoever's responsible. I... I can't do that.
The Price of Ingenuity#540.dst: 昨天跟士兵起冲突之后……Soosu 要我交出负责的人。我……我做不到。
The Price of Ingenuity#540.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#541.src: Rex and {u} caught me talking to her today. That's why... that's why I'm telling you.
The Price of Ingenuity#541.dst: Rex 和 {u} 今天撞见我跟她说话。所以……所以我才告诉你们。
The Price of Ingenuity#541.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#542.src: ...yeah. I convinced him to stop working with her, and to tell you all about it.
The Price of Ingenuity#542.dst: ……对。我说服他别再跟她合作，把事情告诉你们大家。
The Price of Ingenuity#542.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#543.src: We also... stole an important gadget she and Yusanu were working on. Something the Queen was very invested in.
The Price of Ingenuity#543.dst: 我们还……偷了一个她跟 Yusanu 在研究的重要装置。女王非常看重的东西。
The Price of Ingenuity#543.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#544.src: I don't know what it is or what it does. I don't know what it's for. All I know is that the Queen needs it finished. It's all she's had Soosu working on for... months.
The Price of Ingenuity#544.dst: 我不知道它是什么、有什么用。我不知道它是做什么的。我只知道女王需要它完成。好几个月来她就只让 Soosu 做这个。
The Price of Ingenuity#544.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#545.src: I'll try to figure out what it is in my spare time. Maybe it'll help us! I... hope it will.
The Price of Ingenuity#545.dst: 我会利用空闲时间弄清楚它是什么。也许能帮上我们！我……希望能。
The Price of Ingenuity#545.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#546.src: Yulie, Yuman... I owe you a better apology. I can talk to you in private later, but... right now, we should continue with the meeting.
The Price of Ingenuity#546.dst: Yulie、Yuman……我欠你们一个更好的道歉。我可以之后私下跟你们谈，不过……现在，我们应该继续开会。
The Price of Ingenuity#546.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#548.src: ...that was certainly a lot. Fortunately, angering the Sovereign may not ultimately matter. If all goes according to plan... the crown will fall at the end of the festival.
The Price of Ingenuity#548.dst: ……这确实信息量很大。幸运的是，惹怒统领最终可能不重要。如果一切照计划进行……王室会在庆典结束时倒台。
The Price of Ingenuity#548.speaker: Syndra

The Price of Ingenuity#549.src: My goal, as always, has been to find a way to destroy the crown's influence and to free our province. I believe this upcoming festival is an opportunity to do just that.
The Price of Ingenuity#549.dst: 我的目标一直都是找到办法摧毁王室的影响力，解放我们的行省。我相信即将到来的这场庆典正是实现这件事的机会。
The Price of Ingenuity#549.speaker: Syndra

The Price of Ingenuity#550.src: During the Crown Festival, Her Majesty will die.
The Price of Ingenuity#550.dst: 王冠节期间，女王陛下会死。
The Price of Ingenuity#550.speaker: Syndra

The Price of Ingenuity#551.src: Settle down, everyone, settle down! Please, allow Syndra to continue.
The Price of Ingenuity#551.dst: 安静，大家，安静！拜托，让 Syndra 说下去。
The Price of Ingenuity#551.speaker: Quill

The Price of Ingenuity#552.src: It will not be easy. But if we strike when her guard is down, and catch her by surprise, I believe it is possible.
The Price of Ingenuity#552.dst: 这不会容易。不过如果我们趁她松懈的时候出击、打她个措手不及，我相信是有可能的。
The Price of Ingenuity#552.speaker: Syndra

The Price of Ingenuity#553.src: I'll be splitting you all into several groups, and will assign tasks that must be completed before the festival.
The Price of Ingenuity#553.dst: 我会把你们分成几组，分配庆典前必须完成的任务。
The Price of Ingenuity#553.speaker: Syndra

The Price of Ingenuity#554.src: The decision Quill and I have come to is that I alone will be going for the kill. That way, if anything goes wrong... no one else faces the consequences.
The Price of Ingenuity#554.dst: Quill 和我的决定是，由我一个人去下手。这样一来，要是出了什么差错……就不会有其他人承担后果。
The Price of Ingenuity#554.speaker: Syndra

The Price of Ingenuity#555.src: I'll go over the details tomorrow. I think... we've had enough excitement today. Please, hold your complaints until then, as well.
The Price of Ingenuity#555.dst: 细节我明天再讲。我想……今天的刺激已经够多了。也请把你们的不满留到那时候再说。
The Price of Ingenuity#555.speaker: Syndra

The Price of Ingenuity#556.src: Ahem. Yes, indeed. I suppose we should be getting to dinner, as well.
The Price of Ingenuity#556.dst: 咳咳。是的，确实。我想我们也该吃晚饭了。
The Price of Ingenuity#556.speaker: Quill

The Price of Ingenuity#557.src: Yuman... this may be unfair of me to ask, but would you be willing to play us a song tonight? We will not have many days left together.
The Price of Ingenuity#557.dst: Yuman……这么要求可能对你不太公平，不过你愿意今晚为我们弹一首歌吗？我们在一起的日子不多了。
The Price of Ingenuity#557.speaker: Quill

The Price of Ingenuity#558.src: Yeah... yeah, man, of course. I can do that.
The Price of Ingenuity#558.dst: 好……好啊，老兄，当然。我可以。
The Price of Ingenuity#558.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#559.src: Then let us enjoy the remainder of our company!
The Price of Ingenuity#559.dst: 那就让我们享受剩下的相聚时光吧！
The Price of Ingenuity#559.speaker: Quill

The Price of Ingenuity#560.dst: 到 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 观看 Yuman 的表演。

The Price of Ingenuity#561.src: Hey, everyone! Man, uh... small crowd today, huh?
The Price of Ingenuity#561.dst: 嘿，大家好！老兄，呃……今天人有点少，是吧？
The Price of Ingenuity#561.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#562.src: Oh, man, is that Jiro I see? Hey, man! I didn't, uh... expect to see ya.
The Price of Ingenuity#562.dst: 哦，老兄，那是 Jiro 吗？嘿，老兄！我没，呃……想到会看到你。
The Price of Ingenuity#562.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#564.src: Uh, just, you didn't seem super happy with me after... after yesterday. With the- soldier thing.
The Price of Ingenuity#564.dst: 呃，就是，你之后……昨天之后好像不太高兴。就是——士兵那件事。
The Price of Ingenuity#564.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#565.src: ... Oh! Yeah. No worries. Water under the bridge.
The Price of Ingenuity#565.dst: ……噢！对啊。没关系。过去就过去了。
The Price of Ingenuity#565.speaker: Jiro

The Price of Ingenuity#566.src: If... if you say so! Don't think you've heard this one before, so tell me how you like it!
The Price of Ingenuity#566.dst: 如……如果你这么说的话！我想你还没听过这首，所以跟我说说你觉得怎么样！
The Price of Ingenuity#566.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#567.src: But first... Yus. Yusanu. Look, I... I'm not one to hold grudges. So I don't need any more apologies from you! I get it.
The Price of Ingenuity#567.dst: 不过首先……Yus。Yusanu。听着，我……我不是会记仇的人。所以我不需要你再道歉了！我懂。
The Price of Ingenuity#567.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#568.src: I just... want you to trust us more, 'kay? You and Yulie both, haha! 'Cause... I want to help!
The Price of Ingenuity#568.dst: 我只是……希望你多信任我们一点，好吗？你跟 Yulie 都是，哈哈！因为……我想帮忙！
The Price of Ingenuity#568.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#569.src: I had a think, and yeah. It sucks you didn't tell us. But your deal with Soosu- it saved us! Gave us a home, gave us a future!
The Price of Ingenuity#569.dst: 我想过了，嗯。你没告诉我们，这确实挺过分的。可是你跟 Soosu 的交易——它救了我们！给了我们一个家，给了我们一个未来！
The Price of Ingenuity#569.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#570.src: So... this song's dedicated to you. Hope you like it.
The Price of Ingenuity#570.dst: 所以……这首歌献给你。希望你喜欢。
The Price of Ingenuity#570.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#571.src: No... no no no no no, where is it, where IS IT?! I can't... I need to find it, I-
The Price of Ingenuity#571.dst: 不……不不不不不，在哪，到底在哪？！我没办法……我得找到它，我——
The Price of Ingenuity#571.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#572.dst: 这副样子可不好看，统领。
The Price of Ingenuity#572.speaker: Her Majesty

The Price of Ingenuity#573.src: EEP! Y- your Majesty, I- I- I wasn't expecting you until... tomorrow. Wh- what're you doing here?
The Price of Ingenuity#573.dst: 咿！陛、陛下，我——我——我没想到您……明天才会来。您——您怎么来了？
The Price of Ingenuity#573.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#574.src: My schedule freed up, so I decided to check in early. Is something wrong, Sovereign?
The Price of Ingenuity#574.dst: 我的行程空出来了，所以决定提前来看看。出什么问题了吗，统领？
The Price of Ingenuity#574.speaker: Her Majesty

The Price of Ingenuity#576.src: Don't bother. How incompetent must you be, to have lost it from your own workshop?!
The Price of Ingenuity#576.dst: 不用了。你到底要多无能，才会让它从你自己的工作室里弄丢？！
The Price of Ingenuity#576.speaker: Her Majesty

The Price of Ingenuity#577.src: I- I- I don't understand how, my golems haven't been disturbed! They didn't detect anything!
The Price of Ingenuity#577.dst: 我——我——我不明白怎么会，我的魔像都没被惊动！它们什么都没察觉到！
The Price of Ingenuity#577.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#578.src: Perhaps if you focused more on efficiency instead of playing around with your toys, this could have been prevented.
The Price of Ingenuity#578.dst: 如果你把心思多放在效率上，而不是一直玩你的玩具，这件事本来可以避免。
The Price of Ingenuity#578.speaker: Her Majesty

The Price of Ingenuity#579.src: I'll- I'll fix this, I promise! I promise I promise I promise, I can fix it! I can... I can restart! I still have all the research notes, and I-
The Price of Ingenuity#579.dst: 我会——我会修正的，我保证！我保证我保证我保证，我能修好！我可以……我可以重新开始！我还有所有的研究笔记，而且我——
The Price of Ingenuity#579.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#580.src: Enough. I have been lenient with your performance maintaining your district, because I had faith there would be results.
The Price of Ingenuity#580.dst: 够了。我一直对你管理辖区的表现很宽容，因为我相信会有成果。
The Price of Ingenuity#580.speaker: Her Majesty

The Price of Ingenuity#581.src: Restarting the Resonance Weaver project... it cannot be done. That artifact I entrusted you with... that magic is a lost art. It cannot be replicated.
The Price of Ingenuity#581.dst: 重启共鸣编织器项目……这是不可能的。我托付给你的那件神器……那种魔法是失传的技艺。无法复制。
The Price of Ingenuity#581.speaker: Her Majesty

The Price of Ingenuity#582.src: N- no, I have the notes, I- I know how it works, I can do it, just- just give me a chance! I can fix this!
The Price of Ingenuity#582.dst: 不——不，我有笔记，我——我知道它的原理，我做得到，只要——只要再给我一次机会！我能修好！
The Price of Ingenuity#582.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#583.src: I must prepare for the festival. I will expect your presence there, as usual. Please... clean yourself up before that.
The Price of Ingenuity#583.dst: 我得去准备庆典了。我希望你照常出席。拜托……在那之前把自己打理干净。
The Price of Ingenuity#583.speaker: Her Majesty

The Price of Ingenuity#586.src: Consider our agreement null. You have failed me. You will continue your service as Sovereign indefinitely... with your blessing intact.
The Price of Ingenuity#586.dst: 就当我们的协议作废了。你让我失望了。你将无限期地继续担任统领……保有你的祝福。
The Price of Ingenuity#586.speaker: Her Majesty

The Price of Ingenuity#587.src: ...what? No- no, no no no, you- you can't, you can't, you can't!!!!
The Price of Ingenuity#587.dst: ……什么？不——不，不不不，你——你不能，你不能，你不能！！！！
The Price of Ingenuity#587.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#589.src: Rest for the night in your room in the Steel Feather at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
The Price of Ingenuity#589.dst: 到 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 钢羽里你的房间休息一晚

The Price of Ingenuity#591.src: You all go and meet up, now. I have much to discuss with Quill.
The Price of Ingenuity#591.dst: 你们去会合吧。我还有很多事要跟 Quill 商量。
The Price of Ingenuity#591.speaker: Syndra

The Price of Ingenuity#592.src: Training's a pretty good option, all things considered. Let's go before I forget how to string my bow!
The Price of Ingenuity#592.dst: 仔细想想，训练是个挺不错的选择。趁我还没忘记怎么上弓弦，走吧！
The Price of Ingenuity#592.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#593.src: Mmmmm. That bread was really tasty...
The Price of Ingenuity#593.dst: 嗯嗯嗯。那个面包真好吃……
The Price of Ingenuity#593.speaker: Sui

The Price of Ingenuity#594.src: Maybe once we're done training, I should bake another loaf...
The Price of Ingenuity#594.dst: 等训练完，也许我该再烤一条……
The Price of Ingenuity#594.speaker: Sui

The Price of Ingenuity#595.src: The re- reason I got to bed s- so- so late tonight was be- because I'd been up late tr- training...
The Price of Ingenuity#595.dst: 我昨、昨晚那、那、那么晚才上床，是因、因为我熬夜在训、训练……
The Price of Ingenuity#595.speaker: Zeph

The Price of Ingenuity#596.src: I only ha- have a f- fl- flicker of magic... I don't want it to sn- snuff out.
The Price of Ingenuity#596.dst: 我只、只有一、一、一丝魔法……我不想让它熄、熄灭。
The Price of Ingenuity#596.speaker: Zeph

The Price of Ingenuity#597.src: Ah, to train first thing in the morning!
The Price of Ingenuity#597.speaker: Mora

The Price of Ingenuity#598.src: It's no smithing, perhaps, but still a fantastic way to work up a sweat!
The Price of Ingenuity#598.dst: 这或许比不上打铁，但仍是出一身汗的绝佳方式！
The Price of Ingenuity#598.speaker: Mora

The Price of Ingenuity#599.src: If you're reading this note, please turn around!
The Price of Ingenuity#599.dst: 如果你在读这张纸条，请掉头！

The Price of Ingenuity#600.dst: 拜托，这件事就相信我吧。——Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#603.src: Sources of Energy (Solar, Hydro, Geo) - Soosu
The Price of Ingenuity#603.dst: 能源的来源 (太阳能、水能、地热能) - Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#604.src: The Daily Life of a Princess

The Price of Ingenuity#605.src: The Exploration of Magnetic Fields - Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#606.src: Adventures of Sparkles the Unicorn - Soosu
The Price of Ingenuity#606.dst: 独角兽闪闪历险记 - Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#608.src: Sneak through the mansion avoiding guards.
The Price of Ingenuity#608.dst: 避开守卫，潜行穿过宅邸。

The Price of Ingenuity#609.src: The {p} has gone through multiple irrigation methods over the years.
The Price of Ingenuity#609.dst: {p} 多年来经历过好几种灌溉方式。

The Price of Ingenuity#610.src: At first, farmland was watered manually, later shifting to animals carrying larger water tanks.
The Price of Ingenuity#610.dst: 起初，农田靠人工浇水，后来改由牲畜驮运更大的水箱。

The Price of Ingenuity#611.src: Of course, it was my first iteration that began our district's progress. It utilized a network of pipes pulling water directly from the rivers, and distributing it on a timed schedule.
The Price of Ingenuity#611.dst: 当然，开启我们辖区进步的，正是我的第一代设计。它利用管道网络直接从河里引水，再按时间表分配。

The Price of Ingenuity#612.src: After ascending to my position, I continued innovating on the design, in order to...
The Price of Ingenuity#612.dst: 登上这个职位之后，我继续改良这套设计，为的是……

The Price of Ingenuity#613.src: The book keeps going on and on about minor tweaks made to irrigation, detailing every single design. You decide to stop reading.
The Price of Ingenuity#613.dst: 这本书没完没了地讲灌溉系统的各种细微调整，每一种设计都写得巨细靡遗。你决定不读了。

The Price of Ingenuity#614.src: I have recently begun development on an alternative design, utilizing electricity as the primary source of energy.
The Price of Ingenuity#614.dst: 我最近开始研发一种替代设计，以电力作为主要能源。

The Price of Ingenuity#615.src: This book appears empty... Touching it made an odd noise.
The Price of Ingenuity#615.dst: 这本书好像是空的……碰它的时候发出了奇怪的声音。

The Price of Ingenuity#617.src: On my latest reread (the {~}th exactly, by my count), I noted the girl's ability to transport between two coordinates. It was an ability some of my colleagues could replicate through their blessings.
The Price of Ingenuity#617.dst: 在我最近一次重读时 (照我的计数，正好是第 {~} 次)，我注意到那个女孩能在两个坐标之间移动。我的几位同僚能通过他们的祝福重现这种能力。

The Price of Ingenuity#618.src: I've always envied them. It seems a much better blessing than the stupid one I received, I can't stop, I hate it I hate it I ha
The Price of Ingenuity#618.dst: 我一直很羡慕他们。那看起来比我得到的那个蠢祝福好太多了，我停不下来，我恨它我恨它我恨

The Price of Ingenuity#619.src: So I decided to design my own device. Less practical, maybe, but far more creative! If I could transfer a person's matter *exactly*, element by element, precise positioning intact...
The Price of Ingenuity#619.dst: 所以我决定自己设计一个装置。也许没那么实用，但有创意得多！如果我能把一个人的物质*精确地*转移过去，一个元素接一个元素，相对位置分毫不差……

The Price of Ingenuity#620.src: I'll be trying it on my golems first! Just in case.
The Price of Ingenuity#620.dst: 我会先拿我的魔像试！以防万一。

The Price of Ingenuity#621.src: Status: Why why why why why why why?! Why did you think it would work?! Of course nothing good can come of this, of co Cancelled
The Price of Ingenuity#621.dst: 状态: 为什么为什么为什么为什么为什么为什么为什么？！你为什么会觉得这行得通？！这种事当然不会有好结果，当 已取消

The Price of Ingenuity#622.src: It's an old diary. There's a lot of entries... where do you want to start?
The Price of Ingenuity#622.dst: 这是一本旧日记。里面有很多篇……你想从哪里开始读？

The Price of Ingenuity#623.src: It hurt. A lot. But I got through it, because I'm a big girl, and it was important.
The Price of Ingenuity#623.dst: 好痛。非常痛。可是我撑过来了，因为我是大女孩了，而且这件事很重要。

The Price of Ingenuity#624.src: I got my blessing! It's... everything I could have ever dreamed of, and more. I can do so much now- I can get through my plans for the district so much more quickly.
The Price of Ingenuity#624.dst: 我得到我的祝福了！它……是我梦寐以求的一切，甚至更多。我现在能做好多事——我能更快完成我对这个辖区的规划了。

The Price of Ingenuity#625.src: Her Majesty wants to rename the district, to better align with its future... nothing like this has happened since the Penitence District was established, so it's a big deal.
The Price of Ingenuity#625.dst: 女王陛下想给这个辖区改名，好更符合它的未来……自从 Penitence District 设立以来，就再也没发生过这种事，所以这是件大事。

The Price of Ingenuity#626.src: And so, I'm now Sovereign of the {p}! My job is to expand production and raise efficiency, however I see fit.
The Price of Ingenuity#626.dst: 就这样，我现在是 {p} 的统领了！我的工作是扩大生产、提高效率，用什么方法由我决定。

The Price of Ingenuity#627.src: I can better support my family, too... Amastli was only supporting my uncle, but I have authority now, so I can support the others as well. It feels... good. They won't have to struggle anymore.
The Price of Ingenuity#627.dst: 我也更能照顾家人了……Amastli 只供养我叔叔一个人，但我现在有权力了，所以其他人我也能照顾。这感觉……很好。他们再也不必辛苦挣扎了。

The Price of Ingenuity#628.src: When I'm done, I hope no one else will have to, either. I'll make things better. I will.
The Price of Ingenuity#628.dst: 等我完成了，我希望也不会再有任何人得受这种苦。我会让一切变得更好。我会的。

The Price of Ingenuity#629.src: Who was I, back then? Where did she go?
The Price of Ingenuity#629.dst: 那时候的我，是什么样的人？她去哪了？

The Price of Ingenuity#630.src: I have all these resources at my disposal, I can build and tinker to my heart's content, and- it's fun, it is, so why... why do I feel this way?
The Price of Ingenuity#630.dst: 我有这么多资源可以支配，可以尽情地建造、尽情地捣鼓，而且——很好玩，真的很好玩，那为什么……为什么我会有这种感觉？

The Price of Ingenuity#631.src: My only limit is my imagination! If I put my mind to it, I can make anything!
The Price of Ingenuity#631.dst: 我唯一的极限就是我的想象力！只要我下定决心，什么都做得出来！

The Price of Ingenuity#632.src: I've made incredible progress on infrastructure, on machinery to make peoples' lives easier, better, so why...
The Price of Ingenuity#632.dst: 我在基础设施上、在让人们生活更轻松更美好的机械上，都取得了惊人的进展，那为什么……

The Price of Ingenuity#633.src: Why does everything feel so gray?
The Price of Ingenuity#633.dst: 为什么一切都感觉那么灰暗？

The Price of Ingenuity#634.src: ...I turned {~}, yesterday. Three years flew past, and I hardly felt them. Her Majesty is finally letting me start taking the Wellspring water.
The Price of Ingenuity#634.dst: ……我昨天满 {~} 岁了。三年一晃就过去了，我几乎没有感觉。女王陛下终于准许我开始喝 Wellspring 的水了。

The Price of Ingenuity#635.src: You're not really supposed to drink too much of it. I tried anyway. It didn't taste like anything.
The Price of Ingenuity#635.dst: 其实不应该喝太多。我还是试了。它什么味道都没有。

The Price of Ingenuity#636.src: It just looks like normal water, if a bit more concentrated. The same ratios of elements, the same composition and ordering, but... more.
The Price of Ingenuity#636.dst: 它看起来就跟普通的水一样，只是浓一点。同样的元素比例，同样的组成和排列，但是……更多。

The Price of Ingenuity#637.src: I... don't know where I was going with this. I don't know how to write these entries anymore. I don't know.
The Price of Ingenuity#637.dst: 我……不知道我写这些想表达什么。我已经不知道该怎么写这些日记了。我不知道。

The Price of Ingenuity#638.src: It was peaceful. Slipped away in her sleep. She lived a full life, they said, but she wasn't... supposed to be gone so soon.
The Price of Ingenuity#638.dst: 走得很安详。在睡梦中离开的。他们说她这一生过得很圆满，可是她不……不应该这么早就走的。

The Price of Ingenuity#639.src: They never figured out what it was that she had. But I knew. I could see it. I didn't have a name for what it was. But I know its composition. I know its symptoms. I could point it out if I ever saw it again.
The Price of Ingenuity#639.dst: 他们始终查不出她得的是什么病。可是我知道。我看得见。我叫不出它的名字。可是我知道它的组成。我知道它的症状。要是我再看到它，我能把它指出来。

The Price of Ingenuity#640.src: Seeing her, lying there in the casket... I felt like I was barely present. All I could think, was... she looks the same as she always did.
The Price of Ingenuity#640.dst: 看着她躺在棺材里……我觉得自己几乎不在场。我脑子里唯一的念头是……她看起来跟平常一模一样。

The Price of Ingenuity#641.src: Even when she was gone... when all that remained was her body... I couldn't even tell the difference.
The Price of Ingenuity#641.dst: 就算她已经走了……就算只剩下她的躯体……我连区别都看不出来。

The Price of Ingenuity#643.src: Father and Uncle cried. They told stories I'd never heard. Everyone there shared their grief, their love.
The Price of Ingenuity#643.dst: 父亲和叔叔哭了。他们讲了很多我从没听过的故事。在场的每个人都在分享自己的悲伤、自己的爱。

The Price of Ingenuity#644.dst: 可是我什么都感觉不到。

The Price of Ingenuity#646.src: I used to reread these when I felt lonely. I would try and imagine myself as that young, hopeful girl, still full of joy and hope.
The Price of Ingenuity#646.dst: 以前我觉得孤单的时候，就会重读这些。我会试着把自己想象成那个年幼、满怀希望的女孩，那个依然充满喜悦与希望的女孩。

The Price of Ingenuity#647.src: But I can't. A blessing built around my imagination, and I can't even do this one, STUPID THING?!
The Price of Ingenuity#647.dst: 可是我做不到。一个以我的想象力为核心的祝福，结果我连这件事都做不到，这个蠢东西？！

The Price of Ingenuity#648.src: Everyone is growing older, except for me. Uncle passed last year. Father likely doesn't have long left either. Fiona and I grow more and more distant with each and every year.
The Price of Ingenuity#648.dst: 除了我，每个人都在变老。叔叔去年走了。父亲大概也时日无多了。Fiona 和我一年比一年疏远。

The Price of Ingenuity#649.src: I lost her. That little girl. One day she was here, and the next, it was like she was never there at all.
The Price of Ingenuity#649.dst: 我失去她了。那个小女孩。前一天她还在这里，第二天就好像她从来没存在过。

The Price of Ingenuity#650.src: I'm sorry. I'm so, so, sorry.
The Price of Ingenuity#650.dst: 对不起。真的、真的很对不起。

The Price of Ingenuity#651.src: I found my old doll, Flowers. I thought I'd lost him years ago, and it turns out he was hiding in Uncle's old workshop!
The Price of Ingenuity#651.dst: 我找到我的旧娃娃 Flowers 了。我以为好几年前就把他弄丢了，结果他一直躲在叔叔的旧工作室里！

The Price of Ingenuity#662.src: Construction was ongoing at the site, and I had to- it doesn't matter. They'll build over it, instead of tearing it down.
The Price of Ingenuity#662.dst: 那个地点正在施工，我得——这不重要。他们会在上面盖新的，而不是把它拆掉。

The Price of Ingenuity#663.src: But I found him. Physical proof of who I was. And... with my blessing, I could make him real!
The Price of Ingenuity#663.dst: 可是我找到他了。证明我曾经是谁的实物。而且……有了我的祝福，我可以让他变成真的！

The Price of Ingenuity#664.src: I always dreamed of bringing him to life, so I could have another friend! So Fiona and I could ride on his back, and go on adventures, and...
The Price of Ingenuity#664.dst: 我一直梦想着让他活过来，这样我就能多一个朋友！这样 Fiona 和我就能骑在他背上，一起去冒险，还有……

The Price of Ingenuity#665.src: ...and I remembered. For a moment, I remembered how I felt back then! For the first time in so, SO long, I felt... happy.
The Price of Ingenuity#665.dst: ……然后我想起来了。有那么一瞬间，我想起了那时候的感觉！这么久、这么、这么久以来第一次，我觉得……快乐。

The Price of Ingenuity#666.src: I want to feel like that again.

The Price of Ingenuity#667.src: My golems are my lifeline. Flowers was the first, grown from the soil of my youth... and the others followed suit.
The Price of Ingenuity#667.dst: 我的魔像是我的救命稻草。Flowers 是第一个，从我童年的泥土里长出来……其他的也接连诞生。

The Price of Ingenuity#668.src: From now on, I will only make the things I want. I've spent decades building up this district, trapped in pursuit of efficiency above all else, and where did that get me?
The Price of Ingenuity#668.dst: 从今以后，我只做我想做的东西。我花了几十年建设这个辖区，困在凌驾一切的效率追求里，结果换来了什么？

The Price of Ingenuity#669.src: I still love butterflies, sparkles, and flowers! I'd forgotten for a while, but I won't forget again.
The Price of Ingenuity#669.dst: 我还是好喜欢蝴蝶、亮晶晶的东西还有花！我忘了一阵子，但我不会再忘了。

The Price of Ingenuity#670.src: I will make my mark on this world. I swear it.
The Price of Ingenuity#670.dst: 我会在这个世界上留下我的印记。我发誓。

The Price of Ingenuity#671.src: You've reached the end of the section. What will you read next?
The Price of Ingenuity#671.dst: 你读到这一部分的结尾了。接下来要读什么？

The Price of Ingenuity#672.src: On the very first page of the diary, you find a crude drawing of a family.
The Price of Ingenuity#672.dst: 在日记的第一页，你看到一幅画得很粗糙的全家福。

The Price of Ingenuity#673.src: Two parents hold hands, labeled Ma and Pa. To the side of the mother stands another man, labeled "Uncle T." In front of them, a young girl with pigtails (labeled "me!!!") is holding hands with a slightly older girl (labeled "Fiona").
The Price of Ingenuity#673.dst: 两位家长手牵着手，分别标着“妈”和“爸”。妈妈旁边站着另一个男人，标着“T 叔叔”。他们前面，一个扎着双马尾的小女孩 (标着“我！！！”) 牵着一个稍大一点的女孩 (标着“Fiona”)。

The Price of Ingenuity#675.src: I know Ma and Pa gotta work, I do!! But it's so booooring during the day... at least Uncle T does something INTERESTING.
The Price of Ingenuity#675.dst: 我知道妈和爸得工作，我知道啦！！可是白天无——聊——死——了……至少 T 叔叔在做很有意思的事。

The Price of Ingenuity#676.src: He gets to make super AWESOME machines for the SOVEREIGN- ughh, it's so COOL!!!
The Price of Ingenuity#676.dst: 他可以给统领做超级厉害的机器——啊啊，真是太酷了！！！

The Price of Ingenuity#677.src: He's why we have a good house in the city, cause the Sovereign's an important guy, and so Uncle T is also important.
The Price of Ingenuity#677.dst: 我们能在城里住好房子都是因为他，因为统领是个重要人物，所以 T 叔叔也很重要。

The Price of Ingenuity#678.src: I don't super get how any of his stuff works... but, buuuut, maybe I'll get to learn! Best! Day! Ever!!!
The Price of Ingenuity#678.dst: 他做的东西怎么运作我不是很懂……可是，可——是，说不定我能学！史上！最棒！的一天！！！

The Price of Ingenuity#679.src: Slotted in between the pages, you find a crude drawing of a doll.
The Price of Ingenuity#679.dst: 书页之间夹着一幅画得很粗糙的娃娃。

The Price of Ingenuity#680.src: Its body is built of soil, and atop its head is a bright, colorful flower. In the margins of the page, someone has drawn many other kinds of flowers and plants.
The Price of Ingenuity#680.dst: 它的身体是用泥土做的，头顶开着一朵鲜艳缤纷的花。书页的空白处，有人画了许多其他种类的花草。

The Price of Ingenuity#681.src: He's so, so, cool. WAY cooler than Daruma (don't tell Fiona I said that, she'll get mad).
The Price of Ingenuity#681.dst: 他好酷、好酷啊。比 Daruma 酷多了 (别跟 Fiona 说我这样讲，她会生气)。

The Price of Ingenuity#682.src: Ma and Pa are still busy with work... but Uncle T's letting me hang out in the workshop more!!
The Price of Ingenuity#682.dst: 妈和爸还在忙工作……可是 T 叔叔让我更常待在工作室了！！

The Price of Ingenuity#683.src: He even let me help him with a project!! Just screwing in some gears, but still... it's so so so awesome!!
The Price of Ingenuity#683.dst: 他甚至让我帮他做一个项目！！只是拧几个齿轮而已，可是……真的超超超棒的！！

The Price of Ingenuity#684.src: I wish I could help her not be tired so much... oh, I know! What if I could build a machine to help??
The Price of Ingenuity#684.dst: 真希望我能让她别那么累……啊，我知道了！要是我造一台机器来帮忙呢？？

The Price of Ingenuity#685.src: So then she doesn't have to milk the cows all by herself, and we'll have time to play!
The Price of Ingenuity#685.dst: 这样她就不用一个人挤所有的牛奶，我们也有时间玩了！

The Price of Ingenuity#686.src: A sketch of a machine to make milking cows easier. The lines are still rough, and the handwriting messy... but the dimensions seem meticulously measured, and everything is labeled appropriately.
The Price of Ingenuity#686.dst: 一张让挤牛奶更轻松的机器草图。线条还很粗糙，字迹也很潦草……但尺寸似乎量得一丝不苟，每个部分都标注得恰如其分。

The Price of Ingenuity#687.src: He said the design was "genius" and "innovative" and "awesome" (okay, maybe I made that last one up), and pointed out some improvements I could make (I can't believe I missed them!!).
The Price of Ingenuity#687.dst: 他说这个设计很“天才”、很“创新”、很“厉害” (好吧，最后一个可能是我自己编的)，还指出了几个我可以改进的地方 (真不敢相信我居然漏掉了！！)。

The Price of Ingenuity#688.src: I'm gonna show my gift to Fiona tomorrow!
The Price of Ingenuity#688.dst: 我明天要把我的礼物拿给 Fiona 看！

The Price of Ingenuity#689.src: It worked super well too!!!! She got the cows milked in RECORD TIME, and we got to talk the whole time!!!
The Price of Ingenuity#689.dst: 而且效果超好的！！！！她用破纪录的速度挤完了牛奶，我们还一路聊个不停！！！

The Price of Ingenuity#690.src: We even had time to pick flowers near the old Wolie's farm! We haven't done that in MONTHS!!!
The Price of Ingenuity#690.dst: 我们甚至有时间去老 Wolie 的农场附近摘花！我们已经好几个月没这样了！！！

The Price of Ingenuity#691.src: It's stupid, it's hard, I'm always tired.... aaaahhhh!!!! I'm gonna EXPLODE!!!!
The Price of Ingenuity#691.dst: 好蠢，好难，我一直都好累……啊啊啊啊！！！！我要爆炸了！！！！

The Price of Ingenuity#692.src: A drawing of an explosion. An arrow points at the center, labeled "me (in like a month!!!)."
The Price of Ingenuity#692.dst: 一幅爆炸的画。一个箭头指着中心，标着“我 (大概再过一个月！！！)”。

The Price of Ingenuity#693.src: I wish I could spend more time with Uncle T... I tried asking him, cause he's important, but he said he couldn't do anything about my assignment.... ughhhhh!!!!
The Price of Ingenuity#693.dst: 真希望我能多陪陪 T 叔叔……我试着求他，因为他是重要人物，可是他说我被分派的工作他也没办法……呜呜呜呜！！！！

The Price of Ingenuity#694.src: And now Ma's gotten a little sick, so she can't do the hard stuff so much anymore, so I gotta pick up some of it, and- urgh!!!!! I wish the fields would just EXPLODE!!!
The Price of Ingenuity#694.dst: 然后现在妈生了点小病，没法再做那么多粗活了，所以我得接手一些，然后——呃啊！！！！！真希望那些田干脆爆炸算了！！！

The Price of Ingenuity#695.src: A drawing of golden crop fields, exploding. An arrow points at the explosion, labeled "what I'm gonna do (if I gotta keep working!!!!!!)."
The Price of Ingenuity#695.dst: 一幅金黄色农田正在爆炸的画。一个箭头指着爆炸，标着“我要做的事 (如果我还得继续干活的话！！！！！！)”。

The Price of Ingenuity#696.src: There's gotta be a better way to do this stuff. If I had time to tinker, I bet I could figure something out...
The Price of Ingenuity#696.dst: 做这些事一定有更好的办法。要是我有时间捣鼓，我打赌我一定能想出点什么……

The Price of Ingenuity#697.src: Machines are pretty awesome, right? If only they could do some of the work for us...
The Price of Ingenuity#697.dst: 机器真的很厉害，对吧？要是它们能帮我们干点活就好了……

The Price of Ingenuity#698.src: It turns out, if I wanna make a machine that helps farm stuff... I gotta learn about farming... okay, duh, obviously, but STILL. Bluh.
The Price of Ingenuity#698.dst: 原来，如果我想造一台帮忙种田的机器……我就得学种田……好吧，废话，那是当然的，可是还是很烦。呜呃。

The Price of Ingenuity#699.src: Those ones are a little boring, but. But! I told Pa about it, and he offered to read them out for me, just like he used to!! He's had to help with Ma's workload, so he hasn't done that in a while.
The Price of Ingenuity#699.dst: 那些书有点无聊，可是。可是！我跟爸说了，他说要像以前那样念给我听！！他得帮忙分担妈的活，所以已经好一阵子没这样了。

The Price of Ingenuity#700.src: So... that's nice. I guess. Makes it more fun to read that stuff when I'm doing it with him! I didn't ever realize he knew so much about this stuff!!
The Price of Ingenuity#700.dst: 所以……那挺好的。大概吧。跟他一起读，那些东西读起来就更有意思了！我从来不知道他懂这么多这方面的事！！

The Price of Ingenuity#701.src: I also got Uncle T to give me some of HIS books! The ones about inventing, and engineering. They were a fun read! Even though I knew most of it already...
The Price of Ingenuity#701.dst: 我还让 T 叔叔给了我一些他的书！讲发明和工程的那些。读起来好有意思！虽然大部分我早就知道了……

The Price of Ingenuity#702.src: But I know what I'm doing now! And when I have free time... I'll make the super-est duper-est farmer in the WORLD!!!
The Price of Ingenuity#702.dst: 可是我现在知道自己在做什么了！等我有空的时候……我要做出全世界最超级、最无敌的农夫机！！！

The Price of Ingenuity#703.src: It's going to be AWESOME! We'll get to see the Queen, and the Sovereign... and yeah, okay, maybe the official celebration's bo-ring...
The Price of Ingenuity#703.dst: 一定会超棒的！我们可以见到女王，还有统领……好吧，对，正式的庆祝活动也许很无——聊……

The Price of Ingenuity#704.src: BUT. But! Everyone gets the day off work!! And Uncle T always brings back good food, and Ma cooks it up with her own special recipe, and Pa gets me and Fiona gifts... it's the BEST!!
The Price of Ingenuity#704.dst: 可是。可是！大家都可以放一天假！！而且 T 叔叔每次都会带好吃的回来，妈会用她的独家秘方来做，爸会送我和 Fiona 礼物……那是最棒的！！

The Price of Ingenuity#705.src: AND! And because of the super duper farmer, I've had so much free time!! It works GREAT!! Okay, maybe it took a lot of tries to get perfect... but it works NOW, so. That means it's good!!
The Price of Ingenuity#705.dst: 还有！还有因为超级无敌农夫机，我多了好多空闲时间！！它好用极了！！好吧，也许试了好多次才弄到完美……可是它现在能用了，所以。那就说明它很好！！

The Price of Ingenuity#706.src: Don't tell Ma or Pa... but Fiona and I are gonna stay up all night!! We're gonna play with our dolls, and TALK, and HANG OUT... it's gonna be awesome!
The Price of Ingenuity#706.dst: 别跟妈或爸说……可是 Fiona 和我要熬一整夜！！我们要玩娃娃，还要聊天，还要一起玩……一定会超棒的！

The Price of Ingenuity#707.src: Flowers and Daruma are BEST FRIENDS, just like us!
The Price of Ingenuity#707.dst: Flowers 和 Daruma 是最好的朋友，就跟我们一样！

The Price of Ingenuity#708.src: I didn't catch his name... some kinda general or something, I don't know- but he wanted to talk to Ma and Pa.
The Price of Ingenuity#708.dst: 我没听清他的名字……好像是什么将军之类的，我也不知道——可是他想跟妈和爸谈谈。

The Price of Ingenuity#709.src: They told me to stay in my room, but the walls are super thin, so I tried listening in! Still couldn't hear much... but I heard him mention my super duper farmer!
The Price of Ingenuity#709.dst: 他们叫我待在房间里，可是墙超薄的，所以我试着偷听！还是听不太清楚……可是我听到他提到了我的超级无敌农夫机！

The Price of Ingenuity#710.src: I thought I might be in trouble, cause why else would it be a secret?
The Price of Ingenuity#710.dst: 我还以为我惹上麻烦了，不然为什么要保密？

The Price of Ingenuity#711.src: But! But but but, when they all came out, Uncle T said I'd get to be his ASSISTANT!!! No more farm work!!!! And I get to make cool stuff??? Heck yeah!!!
The Price of Ingenuity#711.dst: 可是！可是可是可是，等他们全都出来以后，T 叔叔说我可以当他的助手了！！！再也不用干农活了！！！！而且我还能做很酷的东西？？？太棒了吧！！！

The Price of Ingenuity#712.src: Still... dunno why, but Ma looked a little sad. Maybe she's still not feeling well? I really hope she gets better soon.
The Price of Ingenuity#712.dst: 不过……不知道为什么，妈看起来有点难过。也许她还是不太舒服？真希望她快点好起来。

The Price of Ingenuity#713.src: I got to meet Sovereign Amastli for the first time EVER. Well, okay, sometimes I saw him during the festivals... but STILL!! It's different when I get to TALK to him... duh...
The Price of Ingenuity#713.dst: 我这辈子第一次见到了 Amastli 统领。嗯，好吧，庆典的时候偶尔会看到他……可是还是！！能跟他说上话就不一样了嘛……废话……

The Price of Ingenuity#714.src: He's an old guy, and he doesn't really get how the tech stuff works... I tried explaining, but Uncle T cut me off... hmph. Hmph!!!
The Price of Ingenuity#714.dst: 他是个老头子，不太懂那些技术上的东西是怎么运作的……我想解释，可是 T 叔叔打断了我……哼。哼！！！

The Price of Ingenuity#715.src: The Sovereign just wanted to know what we needed so we could make the super duper farmer easier to make, I guess.
The Price of Ingenuity#715.dst: 统领只是想知道我们需要什么，好让超级无敌农夫机更容易制造吧，我猜。

The Price of Ingenuity#716.src: He also wanted to know how long it'd take us... I don't know how long it'd take us!!!!!!
The Price of Ingenuity#716.dst: 他还想知道我们要花多久……我怎么知道我们要花多久！！！！！！

The Price of Ingenuity#717.src: But Uncle T gave him a date, and he nodded, and said he'd check in closer to then... so I guess we gotta work fast!!!
The Price of Ingenuity#717.dst: 可是 T 叔叔给了他一个日期，他点点头，说快到的时候会再来看看……所以我猜我们得赶工了！！！

The Price of Ingenuity#718.src: Ugh...... ughhhhhhhh........ UGHHHHHH...... I'm so TIRED!!!
The Price of Ingenuity#718.dst: 呃……呃呃呃呃……呃啊啊啊啊……我好累！！！

The Price of Ingenuity#719.src: There's so much we gotta DO, and cause we need it done SOON, I'm always busy!! Busy busy busy BUSY!!!!
The Price of Ingenuity#719.dst: 我们有好多事要做，而且因为很快就要完成，我一直都好忙！！忙忙忙，忙死了！！！！

The Price of Ingenuity#720.src: I had to tell Fiona I couldn't hang out tonight!! I've never had to do that before!!!!
The Price of Ingenuity#720.dst: 我只好跟 Fiona 说今晚不能陪她玩！！我以前从来没这样过！！！！

The Price of Ingenuity#721.src: The work is fun, it IS, I just... ahhhh!!! Maybe it'll slow down after we're done with the super duper ULTRA farmer... I hope so, at least.
The Price of Ingenuity#721.dst: 工作很好玩，真的很好玩，只是……啊啊啊啊！！！也许等我们做完超级无敌究极农夫机，就会轻松下来了……至少我希望是这样。

The Price of Ingenuity#722.src: We were working on a piece of the farmer design, and he was cutting a chunk of metal, and he slipped, and...
The Price of Ingenuity#722.dst: 我们在做农夫机设计里的一个零件，他在切一块金属，结果手一滑，然后……

The Price of Ingenuity#723.src: I, uh, had to go call for help. I ended up running into the Sovereign, cause it was his check-in day, and...
The Price of Ingenuity#723.dst: 我，呃，得去叫人帮忙。结果我撞见了统领，因为那天刚好是他来视察的日子，然后……

The Price of Ingenuity#724.src: ...I don't think he likes me very much.

The Price of Ingenuity#725.src: He just... can't use his arm anymore. So he can't do his job anymore.
The Price of Ingenuity#725.dst: 他就是……再也不能用那条胳膊了。所以他再也没法干他的工作了。

The Price of Ingenuity#726.src: The Sovereign's gonna help pay for uncle's recovery, cause he likes him, or something.
The Price of Ingenuity#726.dst: 统领会帮忙出叔叔的疗养费，因为他喜欢叔叔，还是什么的。

The Price of Ingenuity#727.src: But cause uncle can't work anymore... I get to have his job now. The Sovereign's personal engineer!
The Price of Ingenuity#727.dst: 可是因为叔叔不能再工作了……现在由我接他的班。统领的专属工程师！

The Price of Ingenuity#729.src: Still got deadlines to meet, yup!!! Gotta do all the work myself, yup yup yup!!!! Sigh...
The Price of Ingenuity#729.dst: 还是有截止期限要赶，没错！！！所有活都得自己干，没错没错没错！！！！唉……

The Price of Ingenuity#730.src: Cause making the super duper ultra farmer easy to build took, like, a week!! It was mostly there already, anyway, cause I'm the greatest. Duh.
The Price of Ingenuity#730.dst: 因为让超级无敌究极农夫机变得好造，只花了，大概，一个星期！！反正它本来就差不多完成了，因为我是最棒的。废话。

The Price of Ingenuity#731.src: But now I have all this extra time!!!! So I've been thinking all about other stuff I could do better... like FUEL! It's so... annoying!!
The Price of Ingenuity#731.dst: 可是现在我多了这么多时间！！！！所以我一直在想还有什么别的东西能做得更好……比如燃料！它真的好……烦人啊！！

The Price of Ingenuity#732.src: Gotta get some extra stuff, and keep track of how much the farmer needs, and always resupply it when needed...
The Price of Ingenuity#732.dst: 得多弄些材料，还得记着农夫机需要多少，需要的时候还得一直补充……

The Price of Ingenuity#733.src: I bet I could find a better option.
The Price of Ingenuity#733.dst: 我打赌我能找到更好的选择。

The Price of Ingenuity#734.src: I finally got to show the super duper ultra mega farmer to Sovereign Amastli!
The Price of Ingenuity#734.dst: 我终于把超级无敌究极巨无霸农夫机展示给 Amastli 统领看了！

The Price of Ingenuity#735.src: And he's all frowns as always, bluh, but when I showed off the Energetic Static Super Power, THAT got a reaction out of him, I swear it did!! Eyes wide and everything!
The Price of Ingenuity#735.dst: 他还是一如既往地板着脸，呸，可是当我展示活力静电超能力的时候，那个可真让他有反应了，我发誓真的有！！眼睛瞪得好大！

The Price of Ingenuity#736.src: And then, the next day, he called me into his office, and told me that- and you will NOT believe this- that the QUEEN HERSELF??? Wanted to see ME???
The Price of Ingenuity#736.dst: 然后，第二天，他把我叫进他的办公室，跟我说——你绝对不会相信——说女王本人？？？想见我？？？

The Price of Ingenuity#737.src: I get to go visit THE CITADEL??? And the ROYAL PALACE???? EEEEEEE!!!!!!! I'm so excited!!!!
The Price of Ingenuity#737.dst: 我可以去城塞？？？还有王宫？？？？咿咿咿咿咿！！！！！！！我好兴奋！！！！

The Price of Ingenuity#738.src: Not even Uncle T ever got to go there!!! AHHHH!!!! I HAVE to tell Fiona, NOW!!!
The Price of Ingenuity#738.dst: 就连 T 叔叔都没去过那里！！！啊啊啊啊！！！！我一定要告诉 Fiona，马上！！！

The Price of Ingenuity#739.src: I had to travel with Sovereign Amastli (ugh), but even his ol' grumpy mood couldn't ruin it for me!
The Price of Ingenuity#739.dst: 我得跟 Amastli 统领一起去 (唉)，可是就连他那副老是臭脸的样子也毁不了我的好心情！

The Price of Ingenuity#740.src: It's so... pretty! Like, a million times more pretty than the Agricultural District... no, a BILLION!
The Price of Ingenuity#740.dst: 那里好……漂亮！大概比农业区漂亮一百万倍……不，十亿倍！

The Price of Ingenuity#741.src: And I got to eat so much yummy food... yummier than anything I've ever had! I even got to take some home for Ma and Pa and Uncle T and Fiona!
The Price of Ingenuity#741.dst: 而且我吃了好多好吃的……比我吃过的任何东西都好吃！我还可以带一些回家给妈、爸、T 叔叔还有 Fiona！

The Price of Ingenuity#742.src: Her Majesty was so nice, too?? She showed me around her palace, and said my inventions were super cool!!
The Price of Ingenuity#742.dst: 女王陛下人也好好啊？？她带我参观她的宫殿，还说我的发明超酷的！！

The Price of Ingenuity#743.src: ESPECIALLY the Energetic Static Super Power!!! She said she thinks it'd be a HUGE improvement for the Agricultural District? And that she wants the Sovereign to help me set it up everywhere???
The Price of Ingenuity#743.dst: 尤其是活力静电超能力！！！她说她觉得那对农业区会是巨大的进步？还说她要统领帮我把它装到每个地方？？？

The Price of Ingenuity#744.src: ...it's weird, though. Sovereign Amastli didn't look very happy. And, YES, I know, he's NEVER happy, but... he almost looked... angry?
The Price of Ingenuity#744.dst: ……不过很奇怪。Amastli 统领看起来不太高兴。对啦，我知道，他从来就没高兴过，可是……他看起来几乎是……在生气？

The Price of Ingenuity#745.src: As soon as I saw it, though, he went back to normal. So... still grouchy!!
The Price of Ingenuity#745.dst: 不过我一看到，他就又恢复正常了。所以……还是一样臭脸！！

The Price of Ingenuity#746.src: I just... don't get it. Doesn't he want things to be better for everyone?
The Price of Ingenuity#746.dst: 我就是……搞不懂。他不希望大家都过得更好吗？

The Price of Ingenuity#747.src: We've started hooking it up to all the super duper ultra mega farmers (ha, got to keep one name!), and they're all working SUPER DUPER WELL!!
The Price of Ingenuity#747.dst: 我们已经开始把它接到所有超级无敌究极巨无霸农夫机上了 (哈，总得留一个名字嘛！)，而且它们全都运转得超级无敌好！！

The Price of Ingenuity#748.src: I haven't been able to be home much, and I haven't seen Fiona in a while... but it's okay, cause it's all worth it! I'm making life easier for EVERYONE!! It's IMPORTANT!!!
The Price of Ingenuity#748.dst: 我没什么时间回家，也好一阵子没见到 Fiona 了……可是没关系，因为这一切都值得！我在让每个人的生活更轻松！！这很重要！！！

The Price of Ingenuity#749.src: And... Sovereign Amastli is still helping pay for uncle, so he doesn't gotta work with an injury... but everyone else still has to. Which sucks, cause Ma's also sick and she still has to work, which isn't fair.
The Price of Ingenuity#749.dst: 还有……Amastli 统领还在帮忙负担叔叔的费用，所以他不用带着伤干活……可是其他人还是得干。这真的很过分，因为妈也生病了，却还是得干活，这不公平。

The Price of Ingenuity#750.src: But it's okay!! I get paid a bunch, and I don't NEED most of it, so I've been sending the rest home! That way... they don't gotta work so much, and Ma can finally rest and get better!!
The Price of Ingenuity#750.dst: 可是没关系！！我工资很多，大部分我都用不上，所以我把剩下的都寄回家了！这样……他们就不用那么辛苦干活，妈也终于能休息、好起来了！！

The Price of Ingenuity#751.src: So. Electricity project- all done!! Mostly! It only works for the super duper ultra mega farmers (hehehe, I win, Amastli!!), which is GOOD, but it could be GOOD-ER!!
The Price of Ingenuity#751.dst: 所以。电力项目——全部完成！！大致上吧！它只能用在超级无敌究极巨无霸农夫机上 (嘿嘿嘿，我赢了，Amastli！！)，这样是很好，但它还可以更——好！！

The Price of Ingenuity#752.src: I've been sketching up other stuff I could use it for... it's fun working on something new!
The Price of Ingenuity#752.dst: 我一直在画草图，想它还能用在什么别的东西上……做新东西好好玩！

The Price of Ingenuity#753.src: But. Okay. BIG NEWS. Here it comes.

The Price of Ingenuity#754.src: Her Majesty approached me... and said... she wants ME?? To be a SOVEREIGN??? Whaaaaat??? Huuuuuhhh???? WOOSH, POW- picture my head exploding from the shock!!!
The Price of Ingenuity#754.dst: 女王陛下来找我……然后说……她想要我？？当统领？？？什么——？？？啊——？？？？咻，砰——想象一下我的头被吓得爆炸了！！！

The Price of Ingenuity#755.src: A drawing of the Queen standing, shocked, over a Soosu with an explosion over her head. For good measure, an arrow points to the explosion, labeled "me (exploding)."
The Price of Ingenuity#755.dst: 一幅画，女王站在那里，一脸震惊，面前是头顶炸开的 Soosu。保险起见，还有一个箭头指着爆炸，标着“我 (爆炸中)”。

The Price of Ingenuity#756.src: I guess Amastli's finally retiring? Which makes sense, cause he's an old stinking grouch who's been around a billion trillion years...
The Price of Ingenuity#756.dst: 我猜 Amastli 终于要退休了？这也说得通，因为他是个活了十亿万亿年的臭老头……

The Price of Ingenuity#757.src: ...but Her Majesty said she's looking for someone new, who can help INNOVATE and bring the district into the FUTURE!!
The Price of Ingenuity#757.dst: ……可是女王陛下说她在找新人，一个能帮忙创新、把这个辖区带向未来的人！！

The Price of Ingenuity#758.src: And she says that person is ME!!! WOW!!! Picture my head exploding from the shock, again!!
The Price of Ingenuity#758.dst: 然后她说那个人就是我！！！哇！！！再想象一次我的头被吓得爆炸了！！

The Price of Ingenuity#759.src: The same drawing as before, except now a second, differently-colored explosion is layered over the first one. A brand new arrow points to the second explosion, appropriately labeled "me (exploding {~})."
The Price of Ingenuity#759.dst: 跟前面同一幅画，只是现在第一个爆炸上又叠了第二个颜色不同的爆炸。一个崭新的箭头指着第二个爆炸，十分贴切地标着“我 (爆炸中 {~})”。

The Price of Ingenuity#760.src: It's weird, though. I'd've thought Amastli would be the one telling me the news... I haven't seen him at all since.
The Price of Ingenuity#760.dst: 不过很奇怪。我还以为会是 Amastli 来告诉我这个消息……之后我就再也没见过他了。

The Price of Ingenuity#761.src: I guess I knew he kind of disliked me already, but, still... I don't know what I did for him to not like me THAT much.
The Price of Ingenuity#761.dst: 我大概早就知道他有点讨厌我了，可是，还是……我不知道我做了什么，让他讨厌我讨厌到那种地步。

The Price of Ingenuity#762.src: It's okay, though. Everyone else is super excited for me!! I haven't seen Ma smile like that in what feels like YEARS!! It makes me wanna smile with her!!
The Price of Ingenuity#762.dst: 不过没关系。其他人都超替我高兴的！！我好像好几年没看过妈那样笑了！！让我也想跟她一起笑！！

The Price of Ingenuity#763.src: Ahhhh..... AHHHHH!!!!! I'M SO EXCITED!!!! There's so much I wanna do... I wonder what my blessing will be like?? Super cool, probably, just like me!
The Price of Ingenuity#763.dst: 啊啊啊……啊啊啊啊啊！！！！！我好兴奋！！！！我有好多事想做……不知道我的祝福会是什么样子？？大概超酷的，就跟我一样！

The Price of Ingenuity#764.src: Her Majesty says I'm not allowed to be immortal till I'm a bit older... grrrr.... I'm plenty old now!!! So what if I wanna stay {~} forever!!! Not like I'm gonna grow much more in a few years!!!!!!
The Price of Ingenuity#764.dst: 女王陛下说在我再大一点之前，还不能让我长生不老……呜呜呜……我现在已经够大了！！！就算我想永远 {~} 岁又怎样！！！反正再过几年我也长不了多少！！！！！！

The Price of Ingenuity#765.src: Oh... whatever... Ma and Pa say it's a good idea, and they're always right... so I GUESS it's fine...
The Price of Ingenuity#765.dst: 唉……算了……妈和爸说这是个好主意，他们永远都是对的……所以我大概也没关系吧……

The Price of Ingenuity#766.src: Okay. I gotta go to sleep now. Even though I'm so excited I can barely rest!!!! Ahhhhh!!!!! Ascension tomorrow, ascension TOMORROW!!!! I can't wait!!!!!
The Price of Ingenuity#766.dst: 好。我现在得去睡了。虽然我兴奋得几乎睡不着！！！！啊啊啊啊！！！！！明天就要飞升了，明天就要飞升了！！！！我等不及了！！！！！

The Price of Ingenuity#767.src: It's all just matter, in the end. Building blocks stuck together in new and different ways! Elements of varying ratios glued to one another at a microscopic scale!
The Price of Ingenuity#767.dst: 说到底，一切都只是物质。以崭新而不同的方式拼在一起的积木！不同比例的元素在微观尺度上彼此黏合！

The Price of Ingenuity#768.src: Shift the quantities, the positioning, the makeup... and one thing becomes another! With a wave of a hand, anything can become anything else!!
The Price of Ingenuity#768.dst: 改变数量、位置、构成……一样东西就会变成另一样东西！只要挥一挥手，任何东西都能变成别的任何东西！！

The Price of Ingenuity#769.src: ...Those are people. I know that. I understand that! So why- why do I feel nothing when I look at them?! Why?! Why...
The Price of Ingenuity#769.dst: ……那些是人。我知道。我明白！那为什么——为什么我看着他们却什么都感觉不到？！为什么？！为什么……

The Price of Ingenuity#770.src: I like working with golems. They're easier. Even if one breaks, I know how to put it back together. Even if they're not people, they're just as real to me.
The Price of Ingenuity#770.dst: 我喜欢跟魔像一起工作。它们比较简单。就算坏了一个，我也知道怎么把它拼回去。就算它们不是人，对我来说也一样真实。

The Price of Ingenuity#771.src: ...What is a soul? What is it that people have that my golems don't? I can't see it when I look for it. It's all the same matter. It all looks the same.
The Price of Ingenuity#771.dst: ……灵魂是什么？人有而我的魔像没有的，到底是什么？我去找的时候看不见它。全都是一样的物质。全都看起来一样。

The Price of Ingenuity#772.src: Do I still have one? Did I ever have one? I must have, I remember being happier, I remember it! But when I look, I can't find it. It's all just matter.
The Price of Ingenuity#772.dst: 我还有灵魂吗？我曾经有过吗？我一定有过，我记得自己以前比较快乐，我记得！可是我去找的时候，找不到它。一切都只是物质。

The Price of Ingenuity#773.src: ...The stupid blessing! I can't see it either, but oh do I know it exists. A reminder branded into my skin!! But it's not matter. It's none of the elements, or any of their combinations.
The Price of Ingenuity#773.dst: ……那个蠢祝福！我也看不见它，可是噢，我太清楚它存在了。烙在我皮肤上的提醒！！可是它不是物质。它不是任何一种元素，也不是元素的任何组合。

The Price of Ingenuity#774.src: How can I get rid of something I can't see?! How can I rid myself of something I don't remember living without?!
The Price of Ingenuity#774.dst: 我要怎么摆脱一个我看不见的东西？！我要怎么摆脱一个我根本记不得没有它时是怎么活的东西？！

The Price of Ingenuity#775.src: And even if... even if I succeeded... could I forget what I've seen? It's all just matter. Even if I won't see it anymore... I'll know. I'll know for the rest of my life.
The Price of Ingenuity#775.dst: 而且就算……就算我成功了……我能忘掉我看过的东西吗？一切都只是物质。就算我再也看不见它……我也会知道。我这辈子剩下的日子都会知道。

The Price of Ingenuity#776.src: Why did I ever agree to this?
The Price of Ingenuity#776.dst: 我当初为什么要答应这件事？

The Price of Ingenuity#777.src: Create. Destroy. Create. Destroy. Create destroy create create destroy destroy destroy.
The Price of Ingenuity#777.dst: 创造。毁灭。创造。毁灭。创造毁灭创造创造毁灭毁灭毁灭。

The Price of Ingenuity#778.src: Build and build and build until the action ceases to hold meaning. Then tear it all down, until its components return to the earth, until nothing remains, not even its memory.
The Price of Ingenuity#778.dst: 建造、建造、再建造，直到这个动作不再有任何意义。然后把它全部拆毁，直到它的零件回归大地，直到什么都不剩，连记忆都不剩。

The Price of Ingenuity#779.src: Repeat. Repeat, repeat, repeat until the ends and beginnings can't even be told apart. And then do it over again. And again. And again and again and again and again...
The Price of Ingenuity#779.dst: 重复。重复、重复、重复，直到连结束和开始都分不清。然后再来一遍。再一遍。一遍又一遍又一遍又一遍……

The Price of Ingenuity#780.src: ... failure. No matter how many days I took, the power never ceased to flow. The mark remains.
The Price of Ingenuity#780.dst: ……失败。不管我花了多少天，那股力量从未停止流动。印记还在。

The Price of Ingenuity#781.src: Tried to use my blessing on myself. Grab at the flesh and blood poisoned by the mark, and twist it into anything, anything other than what it is now.
The Price of Ingenuity#781.dst: 试着对自己使用我的祝福。抓住被印记毒害的血肉，把它扭成任何东西，任何不是它现在这样的东西。

The Price of Ingenuity#782.src: Agony. Like the pain from receiving the blessing in the first place, but multiplied tenfold. A hundred times. A million screaming signals from nerves that were no longer real...
The Price of Ingenuity#782.dst: 剧痛。就像当初接受祝福时的痛，但放大了十倍。一百倍。上百万道来自早已不再真实的神经的尖叫信号……

The Price of Ingenuity#783.src: When I came to, the mark was still there. As if nothing had ever happened. Flowers had a cubic meter chunk of soil missing from his body. Easy to repair, but...
The Price of Ingenuity#783.dst: 等我醒过来，印记还在。仿佛什么都没发生过。Flowers 身上少了一立方米的泥土。很容易修补，可是……

The Price of Ingenuity#785.src: There are countless more entries... You skip to the last one.
The Price of Ingenuity#785.dst: 还有数不清的篇章……你直接跳到最后一篇。

The Price of Ingenuity#786.src: The Queen provided me with an out. There's a super-top-secret project she needs done, and I am meant to be the one to do it.
The Price of Ingenuity#786.dst: 女王给了我一条出路。她有一个需要完成的超级绝密项目，而我就是要完成它的那个人。

The Price of Ingenuity#787.src: If I succeed, my blessing will be removed. Finally. Finally finally finally finally FINALLY. Some hope. I just have to do this. I just have to finish this project, and then...
The Price of Ingenuity#787.dst: 如果我成功了，我的祝福就会被移除。终于。终于终于终于终于终于。一线希望。我只要做到这件事就好。我只要完成这个项目，然后……
